name: Veggie Cheddar Omelet
instructions: Whisk the 3 eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt and pepper until fully blended.
Heat olive oil in a nonstick 8-inch skillet over medium heat.
Add diced bell pepper and cook 2 minutes, then add spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Pour eggs over the vegetables, tilting the pan to spread evenly.
Cook undisturbed for 2 minutes until the edges set, then sprinkle cheddar over one half.
Fold the omelet in half over the cheese, cook 1 more minute, and slide onto a plate.

name: Denver Scrambled Eggs
instructions: Cook chopped turkey bacon in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 4 minutes; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add diced bell pepper and onion and saute 3 minutes until softened.
Whisk eggs and egg whites together in a bowl.
Pour eggs into the skillet with the vegetables and reduce heat to medium-low.
Gently push the eggs with a spatula as they set, folding in the cooked turkey bacon.
When eggs are just set but still moist, remove from heat, top with cheddar, and serve.

name: Egg White Veggie Breakfast Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F (175C) and grease a 12-cup muffin tin well.
Finely dice bell pepper and onion, and roughly chop spinach.
Whisk egg whites and whole eggs together in a large bowl with salt and pepper.
Stir in the diced vegetables and crumbled feta.
Divide the mixture evenly among the 12 muffin cups, filling each about three-quarters full.
Bake 18-20 minutes until the muffins are puffed and set in the center.
Cool 5 minutes before removing from the tin; store leftovers refrigerated and reheat before eating.

name: Turkey Bacon Egg Bake Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F (190C) and grease a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Cook chopped turkey bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp; set aside.
In the same skillet, saute diced bell pepper and onion for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a large bowl with salt and pepper.
Stir in the cooked turkey bacon, sauteed vegetables, and half the cheddar.
Pour into the prepared dish and top with remaining cheddar.
Bake 30-35 minutes until the center is fully set and the top is golden.
Rest 5 minutes, then cut into 4 portions.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
instructions: Slice half the banana and mash the other half in a jar or container.
Add rolled oats, Greek yogurt, milk, peanut butter, mashed banana, and chia seeds to the jar.
Stir well until the peanut butter is fully incorporated and no dry oats remain.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours.
In the morning, stir again and top with the reserved banana slices before eating.

name: Berry Protein Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine rolled oats, whey protein powder, and chia seeds in a jar and mix to break up any protein powder clumps.
Pour in almond milk and stir thoroughly until smooth.
Fold in the frozen mixed berries.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours, until the oats have softened.
Stir before serving; add a splash more almond milk if too thick.

name: High-Protein Banana Pancakes
instructions: Whisk protein pancake mix, egg, and milk together in a bowl until smooth batter forms.
Slice the banana; fold half the slices into the batter and reserve the rest for topping.
Heat a nonstick griddle or skillet over medium heat and lightly grease it.
Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter onto the griddle and cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Stack the pancakes, top with reserved banana slices, and drizzle with maple syrup.

name: Blueberry Yogurt Protein Waffles
instructions: Toast the frozen waffles according to package directions until crisp.
While waffles toast, rinse the blueberries.
Place toasted waffles on a plate and top with Greek yogurt.
Scatter blueberries over the yogurt.
Drizzle honey on top before serving.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Granola Parfait
instructions: Slice the strawberries.
Spoon a third of the Greek yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Layer with a third of the granola and mixed berries.
Repeat layering two more times with remaining yogurt, granola, and berries.
Finish with a drizzle of honey on top.

name: Cottage Cheese Pineapple Almond Bowl
instructions: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with fresh pineapple chunks.
Roughly chop the almonds and sprinkle over the top.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

name: Black Bean Sweet Potato Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Peel and dice the sweet potato into small cubes; microwave 4-5 minutes until fork-tender, or roast ahead of time.
Warm the black beans in a small pan over medium heat until heated through.
Scramble the eggs in a lightly greased skillet over medium heat until just set.
Warm the tortilla in a dry skillet or microwave for 15-20 seconds until pliable.
Layer the scrambled eggs, sweet potato, black beans, and cheddar down the center of the tortilla.
Top with salsa, fold in the sides, and roll tightly into a burrito.
Return the burrito seam-side down to the skillet for 1 minute per side to seal and lightly crisp.

name: Turkey Bacon Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook the turkey bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp; chop and set aside.
Add diced bell pepper to the same skillet and saute 2-3 minutes.
Whisk and scramble the eggs with the peppers until just set.
Warm the tortilla until pliable.
Fill the tortilla with scrambled eggs, chopped turkey bacon, and cheddar.
Top with salsa, fold into a burrito, and serve warm.

name: Southwest Egg White Breakfast Wrap
instructions: Warm the black beans in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Pour egg whites into a lightly greased skillet and scramble over medium heat until just set.
Warm the corn tortillas in a dry skillet, about 20 seconds per side.
Mash the avocado half with a pinch of salt.
Spread mashed avocado on the tortillas, then top with scrambled egg whites, black beans, and cheddar.
Finish with salsa, fold or roll the tortillas, and serve.

name: Egg and Cheddar English Muffin Sandwich
instructions: Split and toast the English muffin until golden.
Cook the turkey bacon slices in a skillet over medium heat until crisp.
In the same skillet, fry the egg in a small greased ring mold or free-form to muffin size, breaking the yolk, until set, about 2-3 minutes.
Place the cheddar on the hot egg to melt slightly.
Assemble the sandwich with turkey bacon and cheesy egg between the toasted muffin halves.

name: Bacon Egg and Cheese Bagel Sandwich
instructions: Slice the bagel in half and toast until golden.
Cook the turkey bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp; set aside.
Whisk the eggs and scramble them in the same skillet until just set, or fry into a round patty.
Sprinkle cheddar over the hot eggs to melt.
Layer the turkey bacon and cheesy eggs onto the toasted bagel and serve.

name: Cream Cheese and Tomato Bagel
instructions: Slice the bagel in half and toast to desired crispness.
Spread cream cheese evenly over both toasted halves.
Thinly slice the tomato and layer over the cream cheese.
Season with a pinch of salt and pepper, then serve open-faced or closed.

name: Berry Protein Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Add frozen mixed berries, banana, whey protein powder, and almond milk to a blender.
Blend on high until thick and smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides as needed; add a splash more almond milk only if the blender stalls.
Pour the thick smoothie into a bowl.
Top with granola and serve immediately with a spoon.

name: Tropical Mango Coconut Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Add frozen mango, pineapple, plant protein powder, and coconut milk to a blender.
Blend on high until thick and smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Pour into a bowl.
Sprinkle shredded coconut over the top and serve right away.

name: Honey Walnut Cream of Wheat
instructions: Bring the milk to a gentle simmer in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Whisk in the cream of wheat, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to low and cook 2-3 minutes, stirring often, until thickened.
Remove from heat and pour into a bowl.
Top with chopped walnuts and a drizzle of honey before serving.

name: Protein Cream of Wheat with Banana
instructions: Bring the milk and 120ml water to a gentle simmer in a small saucepan.
Whisk in the cream of wheat and cook 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly for 1 minute so it does not clump the protein powder.
Whisk in the whey protein powder until fully smooth.
Slice the banana and fold half into the bowl, topping with the rest.

name: Avocado Egg Toast with Feta and Tomato
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden and crisp.
Fry the eggs in a lightly greased nonstick skillet over medium heat to your preferred doneness, about 3 minutes for a runny yolk.
Mash the avocado with a pinch of salt and pepper and spread over the toast.
Halve the cherry tomatoes.
Top each slice of toast with a fried egg, crumbled feta, and cherry tomatoes.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast the bread slices until golden.
Spread peanut butter evenly over both slices while still warm.
Slice the banana and layer over the peanut butter.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

name: Classic Vanilla Whey Protein Shake
instructions: Add milk and whey protein powder to a shaker bottle or blender.
Shake vigorously for 20-30 seconds, or blend for 15 seconds, until smooth.
Pour over ice if desired and drink immediately.

name: Chocolate Whey Protein Shake
instructions: Add milk, whey protein powder, and cocoa powder to a shaker bottle or blender.
Shake or blend until smooth with no cocoa clumps remaining.
Pour over ice and serve immediately.

name: Vanilla Plant Protein Shake
instructions: Add almond milk and plant protein powder to a shaker bottle.
Shake vigorously for 30 seconds until fully dissolved and smooth.
Serve over ice.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Plant Protein Shake
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high for 20-30 seconds until smooth and no peanut butter chunks remain.
Pour over ice and serve.

name: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add strawberries, banana, whey protein powder, and milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Add a few ice cubes and blend again briefly if a thicker, colder texture is desired.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Mixed Berry Greek Yogurt Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add frozen mixed berries, Greek yogurt, whey protein powder, and almond milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and thick.
Add a splash more almond milk if the blender needs help, then blend again.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Mango Pineapple Plant Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add frozen mango, pineapple, plant protein powder, and coconut milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth.
Add a splash of water if too thick, then blend again briefly.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Green Detox Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add spinach and almond milk to a blender first and blend until the spinach is fully broken down.
Add banana, whey protein powder, and chia seeds.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until completely smooth.
Pour into a glass and drink immediately, or over ice.

name: Protein Cold Brew
instructions: Fill a shaker bottle or glass with ice.
Add the cold brew coffee, milk, whey protein powder, and maple syrup.
Shake vigorously for 20-30 seconds, or stir well if using a glass, until the protein powder is fully dissolved.
Serve immediately over ice.

name: Vanilla Protein Latte
instructions: Brew 2 shots of espresso (or 60ml strong coffee) and set aside.
Warm the milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until steaming but not boiling, or steam with an espresso machine.
In a mug, whisk the whey protein powder and vanilla extract with a splash of the warm milk until smooth and lump-free.
Stir in the espresso.
Top with the remaining warm milk, stirring gently to combine, and serve hot.

name: Mocha Protein Shake
instructions: Add milk, whey protein powder, cocoa powder, and cold brew coffee to a blender or shaker bottle.
Blend or shake vigorously until smooth with no cocoa clumps.
Pour over ice and serve immediately.

name: Electrolyte Hydration Drink
instructions: Juice the lime and lemon into a large glass or pitcher.
Add the honey and salt.
Pour in the cold water and stir until the honey and salt fully dissolve.
Taste and adjust with an extra pinch of salt if needed, then serve over ice.

name: Cucumber Lemon Infused Water
instructions: Thinly slice the cucumber and lemon.
Add the slices to a large glass or pitcher of cold water.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour to let the flavors infuse, or serve right away over ice.
Refill with water throughout the day, discarding fruit after about 12 hours.

name: Chocolate Peanut Butter Protein Milkshake
instructions: Add the protein ice cream, milk, peanut butter, and cocoa powder to a blender.
Blend on high for 20-30 seconds until thick and smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides if needed.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately with a straw or spoon.

name: Vanilla Berry Protein Milkshake
instructions: Add the protein ice cream, strawberries, and milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 20-30 seconds until thick and smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

name: Pina Colada Protein Smoothie
instructions: Add pineapple chunks, plant protein powder, and coconut milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour into a glass and sprinkle shredded coconut on top before serving.

name: Oatmeal Cookie Protein Shake
instructions: Add rolled oats, whey protein powder, almond butter, milk, and honey to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until the oats are broken down and the shake is smooth.
Pour over ice and serve immediately.

name: Chocolate Banana Protein Shake
instructions: Add banana, whey protein powder, cocoa powder, and milk to a blender.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and creamy.
Pour over ice and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and pepper, then grill or pan-sear over medium-high heat for 6-7 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F internally.
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice into strips.
Warm the cooked rice and black beans separately in a skillet or microwave until hot.
Divide rice and beans between two bowls.
Top each bowl with sliced chicken, salsa, and shredded cheddar.
Add diced avocado, a squeeze of lime, and chopped cilantro before serving.

name: Turkey Hummus Spinach Wrap
instructions: Lay the tortilla flat and spread hummus evenly over the surface.
Layer turkey slices, spinach leaves, thinly sliced cucumber, and sliced tomato over the bottom third.
Fold in the sides of the tortilla, then roll tightly from the bottom up.
Slice in half on a diagonal and serve.

name: Classic Tuna Salad Sandwich
instructions: Drain the tuna well and add to a bowl with mayo and mustard.
Mix with a fork until evenly combined, breaking up large chunks.
Toast the bread if desired, then spread the tuna salad over one slice.
Top with sliced tomato and the second slice of bread.
Cut in half and serve.

name: Greek Chicken Quinoa Bowl
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt, pepper, and a pinch of dried oregano if available, then grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until 165°F internally.
Let chicken rest, then slice.
Divide cooked quinoa between two bowls.
Top with diced cucumber, halved cherry tomatoes, thinly sliced red onion, and crumbled feta.
Arrange sliced chicken on top.
Whisk olive oil with the juice of the lemon and drizzle over each bowl before serving.

name: Southwest Chicken Salad with Lime-Cumin Vinaigrette
instructions: Thaw and warm the corn kernels briefly, then let cool.
Whisk together olive oil, juice of the lime, cumin, and chili powder to make the vinaigrette.
Arrange mixed greens in a large bowl.
Top with shredded rotisserie chicken, black beans, corn, and diced avocado.
Drizzle the vinaigrette over the top and toss gently before serving.

name: Chickpea Salad Sandwich
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas, then mash roughly with a fork in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Stir in mayo and mustard until combined.
Finely dice cucumber and red onion and fold into the mixture.
Divide the chickpea salad between two slices of bread.
Top each with a second slice of bread, cut in half, and serve.

name: Beef Taco Rice Bowl
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, about 6-8 minutes.
Drain excess fat, add taco seasoning with a splash of water, and simmer 2 minutes.
Warm the rice and divide between two bowls.
Top each with taco beef, mixed greens, salsa, shredded cheddar, and a dollop of sour cream.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Place eggs in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let sit covered for 11 minutes.
Cool eggs in ice water, peel, and chop.
Mix chopped eggs with mayo, mustard, and sliced green onion.
Spread the egg salad on one slice of bread, top with the second slice, and cut in half.

name: Turkey Club Wrap
instructions: Cook turkey bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 4-5 minutes, then chop.
Lay the tortilla flat and spread mayo over the surface.
Layer turkey breast, chopped bacon, mixed greens, and sliced tomato.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.

name: Chicken Caesar Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions, then drain and cool slightly.
Season chicken with salt and pepper and grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until 165°F internally, then slice.
Whisk olive oil with the juice of the lemon and a pinch of black pepper.
Toss cooked pasta with spinach, sliced chicken, and the lemon dressing.
Top with grated parmesan and serve warm or chilled.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
instructions: Cook pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions, then drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Drain tuna well and flake into a large bowl.
Add cooled pasta, mayo, finely diced red onion, diced cucumber, and halved cherry tomatoes.
Toss until evenly coated and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill for at least 20 minutes before serving.

name: Loaded Black Bean Baked Potato
instructions: Pierce the potato several times with a fork and microwave on high 8-10 minutes, or bake at 425°F for 45-50 minutes, until tender.
Warm the black beans in a small saucepan.
Slice the potato open lengthwise and fluff the inside with a fork.
Top with black beans and shredded cheddar while hot so the cheese melts.
Finish with sour cream, salsa, and sliced green onion.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a simmer in a large pot, add chicken breasts, and poach 15-18 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return to the pot.
Add diced tomatoes, black beans, corn, cumin, and chili powder, and simmer 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice corn tortillas into thin strips and toast in a dry skillet or oven at 375°F until crisp, about 8 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls and top with tortilla strips, chopped cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Lentil Vegetable Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat, add diced onion and carrot, and cook 5-6 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cumin and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Stir in diced tomatoes, broth, and cooked lentils.
Bring to a simmer and cook 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve hot.

name: Steak and Sweet Potato Bowl
instructions: Pierce the sweet potato and microwave 6-8 minutes, or roast at 425°F for 40 minutes, until tender.
Season the steak with salt and pepper and sear in a hot skillet 3-4 minutes per side for medium, then rest 5 minutes.
Slice the steak against the grain and cube the sweet potato.
Arrange spinach, sweet potato, and steak in a bowl.
Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette before serving.

name: Tofu Quinoa Bowl with Peanut Sauce
instructions: Press tofu to remove excess water, then cube and pan-fry in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until golden, about 8 minutes.
Steam or microwave broccoli florets until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, minced garlic, and juice of the lime with a splash of water until smooth.
Divide quinoa between two bowls and top with tofu, broccoli, and shredded carrot.
Drizzle peanut sauce over each bowl before serving.

name: Turkey Bacon Tomato Sandwich
instructions: Cook turkey bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Toast the bread slices.
Spread mayo on both slices of toast.
Layer turkey bacon, sliced tomato, and mixed greens on one slice.
Top with the second slice, cut in half, and serve.

name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add diced carrot and edamame and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until carrot softens.
Push vegetables to one side, crack eggs into the skillet, and scramble until just set.
Add the cooked rice and soy sauce, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry 4-5 minutes until heated through.
Stir in sliced green onion and serve hot.

name: Black Bean and Corn Burrito
instructions: Warm the black beans and corn together in a skillet over medium heat for 4-5 minutes.
Warm the rice and tortillas separately.
Layer rice, bean and corn mixture, shredded cheddar, salsa, and sour cream down the center of each tortilla.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly into a burrito.
Warm the assembled burritos seam-side down in a dry skillet 1-2 minutes to seal, if desired.

name: Cobb Salad with Ranch
instructions: Hard boil the egg: cover with water, bring to a boil, remove from heat, cover, and let sit 11 minutes, then cool, peel, and quarter.
Cook turkey bacon in a skillet until crisp, about 4-5 minutes, then chop.
Arrange mixed greens on a plate.
Top with rows of shredded chicken, chopped bacon, halved cherry tomatoes, diced avocado, quartered egg, and shredded cheddar.
Drizzle with ranch dressing before serving.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Bowl
instructions: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with fresh blueberries.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

name: Pineapple Cottage Cheese Bowl
instructions: Drain the pineapple chunks if using canned, or measure out fresh chunks.
Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with the pineapple chunks and serve chilled.

name: String Cheese and Whole Wheat Crackers
instructions: Unwrap the string cheese and peel into strips if desired.
Portion the crackers onto a small plate.
Serve the crackers alongside the string cheese.

name: Protein Bar and Apple
instructions: Unwrap the protein bar.
Wash the apple and slice into wedges if desired.
Pack both together for a grab-and-go snack.

name: Hummus and Veggie Dippers
instructions: Spoon hummus into a small bowl.
Cut carrot, cucumber, and bell pepper into sticks.
Arrange the vegetables around the hummus for dipping.

name: Trail Mix
instructions: Combine almonds, walnuts, raisins, and chopped dark chocolate in a bowl.
Toss to mix evenly.
Divide into 4 portions and store in small bags or containers.

name: Classic Deviled Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let sit covered for 11 minutes.
Cool eggs in ice water, then peel and slice in half lengthwise.
Scoop yolks into a bowl and mash with mayo and mustard until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture back into the egg white halves.
Sprinkle with paprika and serve chilled.

name: Peanut Butter Oat Energy Balls
instructions: Combine rolled oats, peanut butter, honey, and chia seeds in a bowl and stir until well mixed.
Chill the mixture in the fridge for 15 minutes to firm up.
Roll into 12 balls, about 1 tablespoon each.
Store in an airtight container in the fridge; serve 2 balls per portion.

name: Apple Slices with Almond Butter
instructions: Wash and core the apple.
Slice the apple into wedges.
Serve with almond butter for dipping.

name: Turkey and String Cheese Roll-Ups
instructions: Lay turkey slices flat on a plate.
Place the string cheese (whole or split into strips) on each slice and roll up tightly.
Serve with mustard for dipping.

name: Sea Salt Edamame
instructions: Steam or microwave the frozen edamame in their pods according to package directions, about 5 minutes.
Drain and toss with salt while hot.
Serve warm, shelling pods as you eat.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Rice Cakes
instructions: Lay the rice cakes on a plate.
Spread peanut butter evenly over each rice cake.
Top with thin banana slices and serve immediately.

name: Quick Vanilla Protein Shake
instructions: Add protein powder and milk to a shaker bottle.
Shake vigorously for 20-30 seconds until smooth.
Serve over ice.

name: Hard-Boiled Eggs and String Cheese Plate
instructions: Place eggs in a pot, cover with water, bring to a boil, then remove from heat and let sit covered for 11 minutes.
Cool eggs in ice water, then peel.
Serve the eggs alongside the string cheese.

name: Savory Cottage Cheese and Tomato Bowl
instructions: Spoon cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with halved cherry tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and finish with a crack of black pepper.

name: Greek Yogurt Granola Honey Bowl
instructions: Spoon the Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Sprinkle granola on top.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

name: Olive Oil Sea Salt Popcorn
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add a few popcorn kernels as a test.
Once the test kernels pop, add the remaining kernels in an even layer, cover, and shake occasionally.
Cook until popping slows to about 2 seconds between pops, then remove from heat.
Season with salt, toss, and divide into 2 portions.

name: Turkey, Hummus, and Pita Snack Plate
instructions: Cut the pita bread into wedges.
Arrange turkey slices and hummus on a small plate alongside the pita wedges.
Dip pita and turkey into the hummus to eat.

name: Cheddar and Apple Snack Plate
instructions: Wash the apple and slice into wedges.
Portion the shredded cheddar into a small bowl or cluster on a plate.
Arrange the cheddar alongside the apple slices and serve.

name: Chocolate Cottage Cheese Protein Pudding
instructions: Combine cottage cheese, cocoa powder, honey, and vanilla extract in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
Chill for 10 minutes before serving for a thicker, pudding-like texture.

name: Sheet-Pan Garlic Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potato & Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F and line a large sheet pan with foil.
Cut sweet potatoes into 1-inch chunks and mince the garlic.
Toss chicken thighs, sweet potato, and broccoli with olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper directly on the pan.
Spread everything in a single layer, chicken skin-side up.
Roast 30-35 minutes, flipping vegetables halfway, until chicken reaches 165F internal and potatoes are fork-tender.
Let rest 5 minutes, then divide between 4 plates.

name: Honey Mustard Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Potatoes & Carrots
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Cut potatoes into wedges and carrots into 2-inch sticks.
Toss potatoes and carrots with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan; roast 10 minutes.
Meanwhile whisk honey, dijon mustard, minced garlic, and remaining olive oil in a small bowl.
Season pork tenderloin with salt and pepper, then brush generously with the honey-mustard mixture.
Push vegetables to the sides, add pork to the center of the pan, and roast 20-25 minutes until pork reaches 145F internal.
Rest pork 5 minutes, slice, and serve with the roasted vegetables.

name: One-Pan Lemon Herb Salmon with Rice & Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F and line a sheet pan with foil.
Arrange broccoli florets on the pan, drizzle with half the olive oil, minced garlic, and a pinch of salt.
Nestle salmon fillets among the broccoli, drizzle with remaining oil, sprinkle with italian seasoning and salt, and top each fillet with a lemon slice.
Bake 12-15 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork and broccoli is tender-crisp.
Warm the cooked rice and squeeze fresh lemon juice over everything before serving.
Divide rice, salmon, and broccoli evenly across 4 plates.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Slice chicken breast into thin strips and toss with cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Add chicken and stir-fry 4-5 minutes until browned and cooked through; remove and set aside.
Add broccoli, sliced bell pepper, and carrot to the pan; stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return chicken to the pan, add minced garlic and soy sauce, and toss 1-2 minutes until glossy.
Serve over warm white rice, garnished with sliced green onion.

name: Beef and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Slice sirloin steak thinly against the grain and toss with cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat until shimmering.
Sear beef in a single layer 2-3 minutes per side until browned; remove and set aside.
Add sliced bell peppers and onion to the pan, stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return beef to the pan with minced garlic and soy sauce; toss 1-2 minutes to combine and thicken slightly.
Serve hot over white rice.

name: Shrimp and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Pat shrimp dry and toss with cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Cook shrimp 1-2 minutes per side until pink and opaque; remove and set aside.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot to the pan; stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return shrimp to the pan, add minced garlic and soy sauce, and toss 1 minute until well coated.
Serve over warm brown rice.

name: Turkey and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Quinoa
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add ground turkey and cook 6-7 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned and no longer pink.
Add diced zucchini, bell pepper, and carrot; cook 4-5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Stir in minced garlic and soy sauce, and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Fluff the cooked quinoa and divide among bowls.
Top with the turkey and vegetable mixture.

name: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Pasta
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions; drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile, season chicken breast with salt and pepper and slice into strips.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken 5-6 minutes until browned and cooked through; remove and set aside.
Lower heat to medium, add minced garlic, and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in half and half, whisk in parmesan, and simmer 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened, thinning with reserved pasta water as needed.
Stir in spinach until wilted, then return chicken and drained pasta to the skillet and toss to coat.
Season to taste and serve immediately.

name: Turkey Bolognese with Whole Wheat Pasta
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions; drain.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and saute diced onion 3-4 minutes until soft.
Add minced garlic and cook 30 seconds, then add ground turkey, breaking it up, and cook 6-7 minutes until browned.
Stir in marinara sauce and italian seasoning; simmer 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Toss the sauce with the cooked pasta.
Serve topped with grated parmesan.

name: Shrimp Scampi with Whole Wheat Pasta
instructions: Cook whole wheat pasta in salted boiling water according to package directions; drain, reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.
Pat shrimp dry and season lightly with salt.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat; add minced garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and halved cherry tomatoes, cooking 2-3 minutes per side until shrimp are pink and opaque.
Squeeze in fresh lemon juice, add the drained pasta and a splash of reserved pasta water, and toss to combine.
Top with grated parmesan and serve.

name: One-Pot Skillet Beef and Tomato Pasta
instructions: Heat a large deep skillet over medium heat and cook diced onion 3-4 minutes until soft.
Add ground beef and minced garlic; cook 6-7 minutes, breaking apart, until browned. Drain excess fat.
Stir in diced tomatoes, marinara sauce, chicken broth, italian seasoning, and dry pasta.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 12-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until pasta is tender and liquid is mostly absorbed.
Sprinkle mozzarella over the top, cover, and let melt 2 minutes off heat.
Serve directly from the skillet.

name: Chicken Tacos with Corn Tortillas
instructions: Dice chicken breast into bite-size pieces and toss with taco seasoning.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken 6-7 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a gas flame, 20-30 seconds per side.
Slice the avocado and chop cilantro.
Fill tortillas with chicken, top with salsa, cheddar, avocado, and cilantro.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the tacos before serving.

name: Beef Burrito Bowl with Rice & Black Beans
instructions: Brown ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes, breaking it apart.
Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water; simmer 2 minutes.
Warm the black beans and corn in a small saucepan.
Divide rice among 4 bowls, then top with seasoned beef, black beans, and corn.
Add cheddar, a spoonful of salsa, and sour cream to each bowl.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.

name: Shrimp Tacos with Avocado Lime Slaw
instructions: Toss shrimp with chili powder, cumin, and a pinch of salt.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp 1-2 minutes per side until pink and opaque.
Mash half the avocado with sour cream, lime juice, and chopped cilantro to make a crema; slice remaining avocado.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet, 20-30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with mixed greens, shrimp, and sliced avocado.
Drizzle with the avocado-lime crema and serve with lime wedges.

name: Turkey Taco Bowl with Quinoa & Black Beans
instructions: Cook ground turkey in a skillet over medium-high heat, 6-7 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned.
Stir in taco seasoning and a splash of water; simmer 2 minutes.
Warm black beans and corn together in a small saucepan.
Divide quinoa among 4 bowls and top with seasoned turkey, black beans, and corn.
Add sliced avocado and shredded cheddar.
Top with salsa and a squeeze of lime juice.

name: Grilled Sirloin Steak with Roasted Potatoes & Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut potatoes into wedges, toss with half the olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast 25-30 minutes, flipping once, until golden and tender.
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Heat remaining olive oil in a cast-iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steak 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, adding butter and minced garlic in the last minute and basting.
Rest steak 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Toss mixed greens and cherry tomatoes with balsamic vinaigrette and serve alongside the steak and potatoes.

name: Baked Tilapia with Quinoa & Roasted Broccoli
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Toss broccoli with half the olive oil and a pinch of salt; spread on one side of the pan.
Mix panko, remaining olive oil, minced garlic, paprika, and salt; press onto the top of the tilapia fillets.
Place tilapia on the other side of the pan and bake 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily and topping is golden.
Fluff the quinoa and divide between two plates.
Top with tilapia and roasted broccoli, and finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon.

name: Beef and Black Bean Chili
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and cook diced onion and bell pepper 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add ground beef and minced garlic; cook 6-7 minutes, breaking apart, until browned.
Stir in chili powder and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, black beans, and chicken broth; bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20-25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Ladle into bowls and top with shredded cheddar.

name: Turkey Chili
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and cook diced onion 3-4 minutes until soft.
Add ground turkey and minced garlic; cook 6-7 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned.
Stir in chili powder and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, black beans, chickpeas, and chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste and serve hot.

name: Lentil and Vegetable Stew
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and saute diced onion and carrot 5 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cumin; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in cooked lentils, diced tomatoes, and broth; bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and stew has thickened.
Stir in spinach and cook 2 minutes until wilted.
Season to taste with salt and pepper before serving.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Rice
instructions: Press tofu between paper towels for 10 minutes to remove excess water, then cube it and toss with cornstarch.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook 6-8 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp on most sides; remove and set aside.
Add broccoli, bell pepper, and carrot to the pan; stir-fry 4-5 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to the pan, add minced garlic and soy sauce, and toss 1-2 minutes to combine.
Serve over warm brown rice.

name: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Cut sweet potatoes into small cubes, toss with olive oil, cumin, and chili powder, and roast 20-25 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Warm the black beans in a small saucepan, mashing slightly.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet, 20-30 seconds per side.
Fill tortillas with roasted sweet potato and black beans.
Top with sliced avocado, shredded cheddar, and chopped cilantro.
Finish with a squeeze of fresh lime juice.

name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
instructions: In a large mug, whisk together protein powder, flour, cocoa powder, and baking powder.
Add milk, egg, and honey; whisk until smooth and no lumps remain.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Microwave on high for 60-90 seconds, until the cake has risen and the center is just set.
Let cool 1-2 minutes before eating straight from the mug.

name: Vanilla Protein Mug Cake with Strawberries
instructions: In a large mug, whisk together protein powder, flour, and baking powder.
Add milk, egg, vanilla extract, and honey; whisk until smooth.
Fold in half the chopped strawberries.
Microwave on high for 60-90 seconds until risen and set in the center.
Top with the remaining fresh strawberries and serve warm.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix peanut butter, eggs, and honey until smooth.
Stir in protein powder and baking powder until a thick dough forms.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop into 12 balls, place on the sheet, and flatten slightly with a fork in a crosshatch pattern.
Bake 9-11 minutes until edges are set. Cool 10 minutes before eating (2 cookies per serving).

name: Double Chocolate Protein Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix peanut butter, eggs, and honey until smooth.
Stir in cocoa powder, protein powder, and baking powder until a thick dough forms.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop into 12 balls, place on the sheet, and flatten slightly.
Bake 9-11 minutes until just set. Cool 10 minutes before eating (2 cookies per serving).

name: Protein Ice Cream Sundae Bowl
instructions: Scoop the protein ice cream into a bowl and let sit 3-5 minutes to soften slightly.
Warm the peanut butter for 15 seconds in the microwave until drizzly.
Drizzle peanut butter over the ice cream.
Top with chocolate chips and chopped walnuts.
Serve immediately.

name: Chocolate Cottage Cheese Protein Pudding
instructions: Add cottage cheese, cocoa powder, honey, and vanilla extract to a blender.
Blend on high 1-2 minutes until completely smooth and pudding-like.
Pour into a bowl or jar.
Top with chopped dark chocolate and chill 10 minutes before eating, if time allows.

name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait with Granola
instructions: Spoon a third of the yogurt into the bottom of a glass.
Layer with half the berries and a sprinkle of granola.
Repeat layers, finishing with yogurt on top.
Drizzle with honey and top with remaining granola and berries.
Serve immediately so the granola stays crunchy.

name: Baked Apple Crisp with Oats & Honey
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F and grease a small baking dish.
Core and thinly slice the apples, then toss with vanilla extract and half the honey; spread in the baking dish.
In a bowl, mix oats, chopped walnuts, melted butter, and remaining honey until crumbly.
Sprinkle the oat topping evenly over the apples.
Bake 30-35 minutes until the topping is golden and apples are bubbling and tender.
Cool 10 minutes before serving warm.

name: Peanut Butter Chocolate Banana Nice Cream
instructions: Peel and slice bananas, then freeze on a tray for at least 3 hours or overnight.
Add frozen banana slices, peanut butter, cocoa powder, and almond milk to a food processor.
Blend, scraping down the sides as needed, until smooth and creamy like soft-serve, about 2-3 minutes.
Fold in chopped dark chocolate.
Serve immediately, or freeze 30 minutes for a firmer scoop.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
instructions: Whisk chia seeds, coconut milk, almond milk, and honey together in a jar or bowl.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight, stirring once after 30 minutes to prevent clumping.
Thaw the mango chunks slightly and puree half of them.
Layer the chia pudding with mango puree and remaining mango chunks in two glasses.
Top with shredded coconut before serving.

name: Frozen Mixed Berry Yogurt Bark
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Whisk together greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract, then spread evenly onto the parchment about 1/4-inch thick.
Scatter the mixed berries, chopped dark chocolate, and shredded coconut evenly over the yogurt.
Freeze at least 3 hours or until completely solid.
Break into pieces and serve straight from the freezer.
Store remaining bark in an airtight container in the freezer.

name: Fudgy Black Bean Protein Brownies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and grease an 8x8-inch baking pan.
Add drained black beans, cocoa powder, honey, peanut butter, eggs, baking powder, and vanilla extract to a food processor.
Blend until completely smooth, scraping down sides as needed.
Pulse in the protein powder until just combined, then fold in chocolate chips by hand.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and spread evenly.
Bake 22-25 minutes until the top is set and a toothpick comes out mostly clean.
Cool completely in the pan before cutting into 8 squares.

name: Peanut Butter Protein Blondies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and line an 8x8-inch pan with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix peanut butter, honey, eggs, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Stir in protein powder and baking powder until fully combined into a thick batter.
Fold in most of the chocolate chips, reserving a few to sprinkle on top.
Spread batter evenly in the pan and scatter remaining chocolate chips over the top.
Bake 18-20 minutes until edges are golden and center is just set.
Cool completely before cutting into 8 bars.

name: Mini No-Bake Cheesecake Bites
instructions: Crush graham crackers into fine crumbs and mix with melted butter.
Press about a tablespoon of the crumb mixture into the bottom of each of 12 mini muffin liners.
Beat softened cream cheese, greek yogurt, honey, and vanilla extract together until smooth and fluffy.
Spoon the cheesecake mixture over the crusts, filling each liner.
Chill in the refrigerator at least 2 hours until set (2 bites per serving).
Serve cold, optionally topped with a few fresh berries.

name: Dark Chocolate Almond Bark
instructions: Line a small baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt the dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl over a pot of barely simmering water, stirring until smooth.
Pour the melted chocolate onto the parchment and spread into an even, thin layer.
Scatter chopped almonds, shredded coconut, and a pinch of salt evenly over the top.
Refrigerate 20-30 minutes until fully hardened.
Break into 8 pieces and store in an airtight container.

name: Greek Yogurt Waffle Berry Shortcake
instructions: Toast the frozen waffles until golden and crisp.
Slice the strawberries.
Stack the waffles on a plate, spreading greek yogurt between the layers.
Top with sliced strawberries and a dollop of whipped topping.
Drizzle with honey and serve immediately.

name: Chocolate Avocado Protein Mousse
instructions: Scoop ripe avocado flesh into a food processor.
Add cocoa powder, protein powder, honey, almond milk, and vanilla extract.
Blend, scraping down sides as needed, 2-3 minutes until completely smooth and mousse-like.
Divide between two small bowls or glasses.
Chill 15-20 minutes before serving for a firmer texture.

name: No-Bake Peanut Butter Protein Bites
instructions: In a large bowl, mix peanut butter and honey until smooth.
Stir in oats, protein powder, and chia seeds until a thick, sticky dough forms.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Roll the mixture into 16 small balls, about 1 tablespoon each.
Chill in the refrigerator at least 30 minutes to firm up (2 bites per serving).
Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to a week.
